name: OpenMontage
description: Agent-driven video production (pipelines, stage directors, checkpoints) for edited videos with graphics, narration, and captions.

install.setup: git clone https://github.com/calesthio/OpenMontage.git && cd OpenMontage && make setup

path.description: The OpenMontage checkout (its own git clone, outside Nexus)

invocation.summary: OpenMontage has no CLI, API, or Python orchestrator: a coding agent opened in the checkout reads AGENT_GUIDE.md and drives the pipeline. Nexus prepares the job and the handoff, then tracks the checkpoints the agent writes.

io.input: A Nexus job file (contract nexus.openmontage.job/v1, see integrations/openmontage/README.md)
io.output: <projectsDir>/<jobId>/renders/final.mp4 plus checkpoint_<stage>.json files; projectsDir is set through OPENMONTAGE_PROJECTS_DIR

limitations: A coding agent must drive every run; Nexus cannot render a video by itself.
Gated stages stop at awaiting_human and need the user's approval in the agent session; Nexus never approves a gate.

Unattended runs are unsupported: upstream says full-run pre-authorization must be logged as a decision_log entry with category approval_policy, but the tested revision's decision_log schema rejects that category.
Paid generation is off unless the job sets budget.allowPaid and budget.maxUsd.
